topics.purpose: Define safe import as parse→normalize→validate→resolve target→semantic diff→authorize→apply, with imported content remaining inert until accepted.

semantics.inert_rule: Imported bytes/text/data are inert and never execute during parsing.
semantics.target_rule: Import target is explicit and exact.
semantics.identity_rule: Existing canonical identities are reconciled explicitly; importer never silently generates conflicting replacements.
semantics.conflict_rule: Same-identity semantic conflicts hard-fail or enter explicit reconciliation.
semantics.authority_rule: Import requires normal target mutation authorization.
semantics.atomicity_rule: Failed import leaves deterministic pre-import state.
semantics.provenance_rule: Accepted import records source profile/file/hash and semantic diff.

invariants.rule: Import/export families resolve exact source/target identities and explicit serialization profiles; conversion never silently changes semantic ownership, identity or authority.

hard_gates.condition: failed import leaves partial ambiguous state

references.purpose: Accepted import crosses the canonical change boundary.
